key.name: warn-threshold
key.summary: Usage percentage from which the indicator turns amber

key.name: crit-threshold
key.summary: Usage percentage from which the indicator turns red

key.name: panel-display
key.summary: What the top bar shows: the percentage, a small bar, or both

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the icon in the top bar

key.name: show-weekly
key.summary: Also show the weekly percentage in the top bar

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Index in the right part of the top bar (0 = leftmost, next to app indicators)

key.name: credentials-path
key.summary: Path of Claude Code's credentials file (empty = ~/.claude/.credentials.json)
